subtechniques.name: Authenticate via question
subtechniques.description: In some cases secret answers to questions might be used to authenticate a communication partner, e.g. with Pidgin where so called buddies must be authenticated. The answer to the question will be send separately and securely, for example with PGP.

subtechniques.name: Dead drop
subtechniques.description: A dead drop or dead letter box is a method of espionage tradecraft used to pass items or information between two individuals via a secret location. By avoiding direct meetings, individuals can maintain operational security.

subtechniques.name: Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol (XMPP)
subtechniques.description: Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol is an open communication protocol designed for instant messaging, presence information, and contact list maintenance. Based on XML, it enables the near-real-time exchange of structured data between two or more network entities.

procedures.name: Adium

subtechniques.name: Internet Relay Chat (IRC)
subtechniques.description: IRC (Internet Relay Chat) is an internet protocol that lets you communicate with people with text in real-time

procedures.name: mIRC

subtechniques.name: Local mesh mode
subtechniques.description: Local mesh mode allows to communicate with others with close proximity, even when internet access is limited.

subtechniques.name: Off-the-record (OTR) messaging
subtechniques.description: Off-the-record Messaging (OTR) is a cryptographic protocol that provides encryption for instant messaging conversations. OTR uses a combination of AES symmetric-key algorithm with 128 bits key length, the Diffie-Hellman key exchange with 1536 bits group size, and the SHA-1 hash function.

procedures.name: Avoid logging OTR conversations
procedures.description: Disabling conversation logging in OTR sessions to prevent storage of decrypted plaintext on disk

subtechniques.name: OMEMO Multi-End Message and Object Encryption
subtechniques.description: OMEMO encryption, OMEMO is a recursive acronym for OMEMO Multi-End Message and Object Encryption. the OMEMO protocol offers many-to-many encrypted chat, offline messages queuing, forward secrecy, file transfer, verifiability and deniability at the cost of slightly larger message size overhead.

subtechniques.name: Add cryptocurrency to darknet market account
subtechniques.description: Cryptocurrency might be added to a darknet market account for placing orders.
